name: Account hacked with poor security
description: Users report accounts being hacked, unauthorized activity, and inadequate customer support response to security breaches.

name: Account recovery and password reset failures
description: Users cannot recover locked accounts or reset passwords after account changes, losing access to their music.

name: Unexpected automatic logout issues
description: App randomly logs users out without warning, preventing them from logging back in.

name: Login failures and connection errors
description: Users cannot sign in due to persistent connection errors or regional restrictions.

name: Account signup blocked or data demands
description: New users face signup failures, excessive personal data requests, or VPN restrictions during registration.

name: Basic features locked behind Premium paywall
description: Free users cannot perform basic functions like song selection, lyrics viewing, or skipping without upgrading.

name: Premium subscription pricing too expensive
description: Users find Spotify's subscription plans increasingly costly and unaffordable.

name: Refunds denied for service failures
description: Users report being denied refunds or credits when services fail or don't work as promised.

name: Subscription activation and payment errors
description: Users encounter errors when activating subscriptions or making payments through the app.

name: Unauthorized charges after cancellation
description: Users report being charged after canceling subscriptions or being billed without authorization.

name: Lyrics missing or not loading
description: Song lyrics are unavailable, not loading, or have been removed from the app.

name: Songs and albums removed or unavailable
description: Users cannot find favorite songs or albums that were previously available on the platform.

name: Podcast and audiobook playback issues
description: Users experience problems following podcasts, tracking progress, or playing audiobook content.

name: Unwanted songs added to playlists automatically
description: App adds random or unrelated songs to user playlists without permission.

name: Search function fails to load results
description: Users cannot search for songs effectively due to loading failures or incomplete results.

name: Songs fail to download for offline use
description: Users cannot download songs or albums to their device for offline listening.

name: Downloaded songs repeatedly disappear
description: Downloaded music vanishes and requires constant re-downloading, causing frustration.

name: Offline mode not working or unavailable
description: Downloaded songs won't play offline or offline mode is missing after updates.

name: Cannot save downloads to SD card
description: App prevents saving downloaded music to external storage, wasting phone space.

name: General app malfunction and poor quality
description: Users express broad dissatisfaction with app functionality, performance, and overall quality.

name: Unrelated complaints and unclear issues
description: Users report concerns unrelated to app functionality or express unclear grievances.

name: Poor audio quality and volume control
description: Users report low sound quality, inability to adjust quality settings, or volume jumping between songs.

name: Unwanted background playback and autostart
description: App starts automatically in background, plays on lockscreen, or runs without user control.

name: Excessive battery and data consumption
description: App drains battery quickly and uses excessive mobile data or storage.

name: Sudden disconnection and offline errors
description: App loses connection despite strong internet or incorrectly reports offline status.

name: App crashes or fails to open
description: App crashes when playing songs, shows black screen, or won't launch properly.

name: Device connectivity and cross-device sync issues
description: Users cannot connect to Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, or sync playback across devices.

name: Constant lag and loading delays
description: App runs slowly with frequent loading screens and poor performance overall.

name: Playback stops or skips to next song unexpectedly
description: Music cuts out, stops playing, or fails to continue to the next song automatically.

name: Customer support ignores user messages
description: Users report customer support not responding to messages or being unreachable.

name: Customer support provides unhelpful responses
description: Support staff give generic, repetitive, or rude responses that don't resolve issues.

name: Excessive ads in free version
description: Free users are bombarded with frequent, repetitive ads that interrupt listening experience.

name: Poor navigation and missing customization options
description: Users struggle with app layout, missing controls like alphabet slider, or forced shuffle mode.

name: Confusing queue and playlist controls
description: Queue management is unintuitive and difficult; playlist creation and management are complicated.

name: Shuffle adds unwanted songs and blocks skipping
description: Smart shuffle adds songs outside playlists and prevents users from skipping or selecting specific songs.

name: UI redesign cluttered and difficult to use
description: Recent app redesign makes navigation confusing, adds unwanted video content, and looks visually unappealing.
